name: Burnsville Farmers' Market - Parkway
description: Burnsville Farmers' Market - Parkway is a farmers market in 200 Burnsville Pkwy, MN, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
